shots.say: Can slow Tula finish the big ocean race? Look! The fast fish zoom right past her!
shots.tag: hook: the fish zoom past Tula

shots.say: The Animated Zoo!
Hello, I'm Milo! Today is the big ocean race, and I am the helper on the rock.
shots.tag: start wide: Milo on his rock

shots.say: Here are the swimmers. Zip the yellow fish, Pearl the pink fish, and my friend Tula the sea turtle.
Swim all the way to the Big Rock, and touch the gold star!
I am Zip, and I am super fast! I will be there first!
I am fast too! Tula, you are so slow. Hee hee!
I am slow. But I want to try. I want to touch the gold star too!
Who is the slow swimmer? Zip, or Tula?
Ready, steady, go! Zip and Pearl zoom away. And Tula paddles, nice and slow.
The fish are so fast! Soon they are far, far away. And Tula is all the way at the back.
shots.tag: the fish far away, Tula at the back

shots.say: Wait for me, friends! Oh. They are gone already.
Who is at the back of the race? Tula, or Pearl?
shots.tag: question: who is at the back

shots.say: I am slow, but I am steady. Paddle, paddle. I will not stop!
Green sea turtles have flippers, shaped like paddles. Flippers help them move easily through the water.
What are Tula's flippers shaped like? Paddles, or wheels?
Can you paddle with your arms, like me? Paddle, paddle, paddle!
Far ahead, Zip and Pearl zoom into the seagrass meadow. But the grass is tall and thick!
shots.tag: the fish zoom into the seagrass

shots.say: Oh no! I cannot zoom in here. The grass tickles my tummy!
We have to wiggle, slowly, slowly. This takes so long!
Can the fish swim fast in the tall grass? Yes, or no?
shots.tag: question: fast in the grass yes or no

shots.say: Next, the fish come to two ways. One is dark, and one is bright. Which one goes to the Big Rock?
No time to think! This way, quick!
Zip and Pearl zoom into the dark way. But it only goes round, and round, and round.
And look where they come out. Back at the seagrass meadow! That was the wrong way.
Was the dark way the right way? Yes, or no?
shots.tag: question: right way yes or no

shots.say: Zip and Pearl sink down to the soft sand. They swam so fast, and now they are very tired.
shots.tag: the fish rest on the sand

shots.say: My tail is too tired to wag. Maybe we cannot finish the race.
We went so fast. And we are still not there.
How do the fish feel now? Tired, or fast?
Then, paddle, paddle, here comes Tula! Slow and steady, she never stopped.
Tula! You are still swimming? How do you keep going?
shots.tag: Zip: how do you keep going

shots.say: I do not hurry. I paddle, and paddle, and I take my time.
And look! Tula nibbles the seagrass. Grown-up green sea turtles eat plants, like seagrass.
What does a grown-up green sea turtle eat? Seagrass, or pizza?
Tula made a path in the grass! Now we can all swim through.
shots.tag: Pearl: a path in the grass

shots.say: Soon they are back at the two ways. This time, nobody rushes. Tula stops, and thinks.
shots.tag: back at the two ways: stop and think

shots.say: Green sea turtles travel long distances, even across oceans.
shots.tag: fact: long trips across the sea

shots.say: I have been this way before. The bright way goes to the Big Rock!
Which way goes to the Big Rock? The dark way, or the bright way?
I have an idea! Let's not zoom. Let's swim slow and steady, right behind Tula!
Yes! All together!
So the three friends swim through the coral garden, side by side. Nobody zooms, and nobody gets tired.
shots.tag: the coral garden, side by side

shots.say: Let's count Tula's paddles! One, two, three!
Slow and steady, here we go. Paddle, paddle, nice and slow!
And there it is. The Big Rock! Milo waves from the top.
Tula, Zip and Pearl touch the gold star, all at the same time!
shots.tag: they touch the gold star together

shots.say: Hooray! Everybody finished the race! A gold star for all three of you!
Did slow Tula finish the big race? Yes, or no?
shots.tag: question: did Tula finish yes or no

shots.say: The sun goes down, and the sea turns gold. The three friends rest beside the Big Rock.
Thank you, Tula! You showed us the way.
And you swam with me. A race is more fun with friends!
You do not have to be the fastest. Keep going, a little bit at a time, and you will get there.
Do you remember? What are a sea turtle's flippers shaped like? Paddles, or spoons?
And what do grown-up green sea turtles eat? Seagrass, or sand?
Slow and steady, here we go. Paddle, paddle, nice and slow!
Next time: A New House for Little Crab! See you on the next adventure, friends!
The Animated Zoo!
